headline: Fed Holds Rates at 3.75%-4.00% as Inflation Remains Elevated
summary: The US Federal Reserve maintained interest rates at 3.75% to 4%, while the South African rand held steady at 16.65 per dollar and South Africa's Reserve Bank is expected to hold.
why: Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions set the baseline for global interest rates, cross-border capital flows, and international borrowing costs.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: Interest rate pauses maintain existing yield differentials against other currencies.

why_moved: The Federal Reserve left the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.75% to 4%, stabilizing major currency pairs.
